profile.visual_desc: Red-scaled dragonman with large bat-like wings and a thick tail. Wears grey plate armor on the lower body and shoulders over red cloth wraps.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Intense reptilian features with red scales and piercing red slitted eyes. Features prominent horns and fin-like ears with a stern expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Large silver straight sword held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Low crouch with wings partially folded and sword held upright over the shoulder.
profile.step2_windup: Wings flare wide as the body rotates. The sword is pulled back and then swung in a sharp horizontal arc.
profile.step3_impact: Rapid thrust forward. A long, straight golden energy beam extends from the blade tip toward the upper-left corner.
profile.step4_finish: Sword completes the swing as the energy trail dissipates. Wings begin folding back to the original ready position.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy beam in Frame 4 must extend directly from the sword tip, following the straight diagonal line toward the top-left.

evaluation.diagnosis: Perspective and grip consistent. Windup/swing match reference. VFX timing and alignment accurate.
